byte_protocol.unterminated_last_record: complete only for a length-verified HTTP 200 body
byte_protocol.typed_decoding: ASCII only; retain other bytes and leave affected interpretation unresolved

paper_header.original_id_use: unused by publisher; never an amendment edge

dispositions.financial_cover_present: One supported cover contains valid nonblank amounts. Not a complete or effective financial report; other schedule layouts need not be supported.
dispositions.supplemental_attachment_shape: Complete paper response has one valid-identity/period F3X cover, every amount field blank, and only same-filer substantive SC1 records after it. This describes the transcription, not independently verified original-image contents.
dispositions.unresolved: Unsupported, incomplete, invalid, blank-without-supplement, mixed, or multi-cover scope. Keep all record bytes and explicit issues.

metadata: Re-read at most four pinned report-metadata captures; preserve exact matching records and literal field/type differences. Missing metadata does not erase document-shape evidence. No endpoint precedence or inferred family links.
